description: While a reprocess runs, the client asks the Pending check (GET /v1/activities/pending) about the rows its list shows Pending and the edits it saved, and reads the list again once one of them is no longer Pending. Expected: watched (the ids asked about, once each, listed first) and moved (whether the list is read again), given the check's answer stillPending.

cases.name: an edit saved here is watched too, once
an edit that landed before the list saw it Pending
